<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A1.I2.i4.p1.2" class="ltx_p">Reported runs use <math id="A1.I2.i4.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\eta_{v}=\xi_{v}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>η</mi><mi>v</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>ξ</mi><mi>v</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\eta_{v}=\xi_{v}=0</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A1.I2.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A1.I2.i5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.I2.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><math id="A1.I2.i5.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T^{k}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi>T</mi><mi>k</mi></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T^{k}</annotation></semantics></math>: <math id="A1.I2.i5.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="M_{v}=\Exp(i\,\operatorname{diag}(\beta_{v}))" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>M</mi><mi>v</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>exp</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo lspace="0.337em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>diag</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>β</mi><mi>v</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">M_{v}=\Exp(i\,\operatorname{diag}(\beta_{v}))</annotation></semantics></math>, <math id="A1.I2.i5.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="P_{v}=\Exp(i\,\operatorname{diag}(\gamma_{v}))" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>P</mi><mi>v</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>exp</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo lspace="0.337em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>diag</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>γ</mi><mi>v</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">P_{v}=\Exp(i\,\operatorname{diag}(\gamma_{v}))</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
<p id="A1.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.2" class="ltx_p">Because <math id="A1.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Exp" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>exp</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Exp</annotation></semantics></math> of a skew-symmetric matrix has determinant <math id="A1.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="+1" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+1</annotation></semantics></math>, the <math id="A1.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\eta_{v}=\xi_{v}=0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>η</mi><mi>v</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>ξ</mi><mi>v</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\eta_{v}=\xi_{v}=0</annotation></semantics></math> setting lies in <math id="A1.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathrm{SO}(d)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>SO</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>d</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathrm{SO}(d)</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A1.SS2" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">A.2 </span>Tangent-map approximations</h3>

<div id="A1.SS2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.SS2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The template component <math id="A1.SS2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Gamma:\mathfrak{g}\to\mathfrak{g}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo lspace="0.278em" rspace="0.278em">:</mo><mrow><mi>𝔤</mi><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mi>𝔤</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Gamma:\mathfrak{g}\to\mathfrak{g}</annotation></semantics></math> is implemented in subgroup coordinates.
Let <math id="A1.SS2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="n_{\mathfrak{g}}=\dim(\mathfrak{g})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>𝔤</mi></msub><mo rspace="0.1389em">=</mo><mrow><mo lspace="0.1389em" rspace="0em">dim</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>𝔤</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n_{\mathfrak{g}}=\dim(\mathfrak{g})</annotation></semantics></math> and fix
<math id="A1.SS2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathrm{vec}_{\mathfrak{g}}:\mathfrak{g}\to\mathbb{R}^{n_{\mathfrak{g}}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>vec</mi><mi>𝔤</mi></msub><mo lspace="0.278em" rspace="0.278em">:</mo><mrow><mi>𝔤</mi><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><msup><mi>ℝ</mi><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>𝔤</mi></msub></msup></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathrm{vec}_{\mathfrak{g}}:\mathfrak{g}\to\mathbb{R}^{n_{\mathfrak{g}}}</annotation></semantics></math>
with inverse
<math id="A1.SS2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathrm{vec}_{\mathfrak{g}}^{-1}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>vec</mi><mi>𝔤</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathrm{vec}_{\mathfrak{g}}^{-1}</annotation></semantics></math>.
For <math id="A1.SS2.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="A\in\mathfrak{g}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>𝔤</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A\in\mathfrak{g}</annotation></semantics></math>, write <math id="A1.SS2.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="a=\mathrm{vec}_{\mathfrak{g}}(A)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>vec</mi><mi>𝔤</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>A</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a=\mathrm{vec}_{\mathfrak{g}}(A)</annotation></semantics></math> and set</p>
<table id="A1.Ex29" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A1.Ex29.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Gamma(A)=\mathrm{vec}_{\mathfrak{g}}^{-1}(\phi(a))." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Γ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>A</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><msubsup><mi>vec</mi><mi>𝔤</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msubsup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>ϕ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Gamma(A)=\mathrm{vec}_{\mathfrak{g}}^{-1}(\phi(a)).</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A1.SS2.p1.2" class="ltx_p">Choices used in this manuscript are:</p>
<ol id="A1.I3" class="ltx_enumerate" style="--ltx-enum-leftmargin:1.5em;">
<li id="A1.I3.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">1.</span> 
<div id="A1.I3.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.I3.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Identity:</span> <math id="A1.I3.i1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\phi(a)=a" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>ϕ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\phi(a)=a</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A1.I3.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">2.</span> 
<div id="A1.I3.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.I3.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Per-direction scaling:</span> <math id="A1.I3.i2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\phi(a)=s\odot a" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>ϕ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">⊙</mo><mi>a</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\phi(a)=s\odot a</annotation></semantics></math>, with <math id="A1.I3.i2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="s\in\mathbb{R}^{n_{\mathfrak{g}}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>∈</mo><msup><mi>ℝ</mi><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>𝔤</mi></msub></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s\in\mathbb{R}^{n_{\mathfrak{g}}}</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A1.I3.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">3.</span> 
<div id="A1.I3.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.I3.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Linear mixing:</span> <math id="A1.I3.i3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\phi(a)=Wa" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mi>ϕ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>W</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>a</mi></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\phi(a)=Wa</annotation></semantics></math>, with <math id="A1.I3.i3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="W\in\mathbb{R}^{n_{\mathfrak{g}}\times n_{\mathfrak{g}}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>W</mi><mo>∈</mo><msup><mi>ℝ</mi><mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>𝔤</mi></msub><mo lspace="0.222em" rspace="0.222em">×</mo><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>𝔤</mi></msub></mrow></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">W\in\mathbb{R}^{n_{\mathfrak{g}}\times n_{\mathfrak{g}}}</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div></li>
</ol>
<p id="A1.SS2.p1.3" class="ltx_p">This construction is subgroup-agnostic once <math id="A1.SS2.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathfrak{g}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>𝔤</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathfrak{g}</annotation></semantics></math> coordinates are fixed.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A1.SS3" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">A.3 </span>Update-map approximations</h3>

<div id="A1.SS3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.SS3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The reference group step is</p>
<table id="A1.Ex30" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A1.Ex30.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="H\leftarrow H\Exp(A),\qquad A\in\mathfrak{g}." display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>H</mi><mo stretchy="false">←</mo><mrow><mi>H</mi><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>exp</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>A</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo rspace="2.167em">,</mo><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>𝔤</mi></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">H\leftarrow H\Exp(A),\qquad A\in\mathfrak{g}.</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A1.SS3.p1.2" class="ltx_p">Computational approximations can replace <math id="A1.SS3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\Exp" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>exp</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Exp</annotation></semantics></math> (for example, Cayley-type maps or truncated series), optionally followed by subgroup re-projection if exact subgroup constraints are required at each step.</p>
</div>
<div id="A1.SS3.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A1.SS3.p2.1" class="ltx_p">The experiments section instantiates these choices for the reported <math id="A1.SS3.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathrm{O}(d)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>O</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>d</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathrm{O}(d)</annotation></semantics></math> runs.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
